event.description: Union closest shared FF-output scalar groups 95 and 52
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,700 parameters at 99.030000%, a +0.030000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 29 prior macro-attempts in this family and 411 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0087/micro-0004 at 1700 parameters and 99.030000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0086/micro-0001 (discard, 3.820000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 95 and 52, values -0.0073389588 and -0.0072220834 (difference 1.169e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,699 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 1.223e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
